title: Authentication & Permissions in DRF
description: Secure your API with token authentication and permission classes.

slides.title: Authentication vs Permissions 🔐
slides.content:
In DRF, **authentication** identifies the user (who they are), while **permissions** determine what actions they can take.

DRF provides several authentication classes:
- `SessionAuthentication` – uses Django's session (for browsable API).
- `TokenAuthentication` – simple token‑based authentication.
- `BasicAuthentication` – HTTP Basic Auth (not recommended for production without HTTPS).

Permissions classes control access to views or actions.

slides.title: Token Authentication Setup

quizData.question: Which app must be added to INSTALLED_APPS to use token authentication?
quizData.explanation: `rest_framework.authtoken` provides the Token model and views to generate tokens.

slides.title: Generating Tokens
slides.content:
# Create a token for a user
from rest_framework.authtoken.models import Token
token = Token.objects.create(user=some_user)
print(token.key)

# Or use the built‑in view to obtain token (requires username/password)
# POST to /api-token-auth/ with username and password

# In your API requests, include the token in the Authorization header:
# Authorization: Token 9944b09199c62bcf9418ad846dd0e4bbdfc6ee4b

slides.title: Using Permissions
slides.content:
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated, IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly
from rest_framework import viewsets

class PostViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Post.objects.all()
    serializer_class = PostSerializer
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticatedOrReadOnly]  # read for all, write for authenticated

    # Override perform_create to set author automatically
    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        serializer.save(author=self.request.user)

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Combine permission classes for fine‑grained control

You can list multiple permission classes; they all must pass for access. You can also create custom permission classes by subclassing `BasePermission`.
